agiEmergence.meaning: At least one institution holds recognized AGI.

$conditions.singularity: AGI is recognized and average final Reputation is at least 3.
$conditions.closed_loop: AGI is recognized and average final Reputation is below 3.
$conditions.plural_future: AGI is not recognized and average final Reputation is at least 3.
$conditions.assured_continuity: AGI is not recognized and average final Reputation is below 3.

title: ${game.title}

scoreDisplay.name: Mandate
scoreDisplay.description: Mandate = Capability + 2 × Customers + Reputation + 4 for recognized AGI + revealed objectives.
scoreDisplay.instructions: Keep the identity card upright until recognition; rotate it half a turn if AGI is recognized. After scoring, align its upper-edge pointer with the final Mandate tick below your mat. Leave holdings and Orgs in place.

turnReference: Optional trade, then stay or move one edge and perform that hex’s Action. Three cycles per Era; twelve turns each. At Era end, placed Orgs produce their hex yield (twice if equipped), then resolve Reputation Review.
